title: Other Dental Conditions
summary: Advise dental consultation for treatment of other dental infections including acute necrotising gingivitis, pericoronitis and inflammation/ulceration of the oral mucosa. See BNF for treatment information if necessary. Referral to hospital is required if patient has severe symptoms, such as significant trismus, floor-of-mouth swelling or difficulty breathing.
